{{Quote|In addition to the already-reported promotion of Saul Karath of the ''Courageous'' to Rear Admiral, the latest promotions were handed down from the Republic Navy &hellip; <br />'''To Lieutenant:'''<br />Rutu of Moltok.|The Admiral's List|<ref name="TAL" />}}
'''Rutu''' was a native of [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]],<ref name="TAL" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of huge [[Water/Legends|rain]]-[[Tree/Legends|forests]]<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> The [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="CSWE" /> This war, between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent forces of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], began in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorians]] made a three-pronged assault against the Republic in [[3963 BBY]]. In the aftermath of this assault, known by the Republic media as the "Onslaught," Rutu received a promotion to the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. His promotion, reported in the [[The Admiral's List: Jimas Veltraa Memorial Edition|Jimas Veltraa Memorial Edition]] of ''[[The Admiral's List]]'', an official publication of the Republic Navy, occurred alongside that of notable officer [[Saul Karath]] to [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]].<ref name="TAL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rutu was created by [[John Jackson Miller]], the author of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], and was mentioned in ''[[The Admiral's List: Jimas Veltraa Memorial Edition]]'', appended to [[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]. This [[in-universe]] news source is designed as "an official communique for the Republic providing news from the 'regular navy' point of view," inspired by the "Napoleonic-era Britain's Naval Chronicle."<ref>{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=Help/Boards/viewtopic.php?p=143036|thread=News from the world of KOTOR -- literally!|user=John Jackson Miller|date=2006-12-18|time=12:27 pm}} on the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse Forums]] {{C|Posted 12/18/2006 12.27 PM by John Jackson Miller}}</ref> Some of the promotions presented here are said to be confirmations of ones received on the battlefield, but it is not specified which these are or which are regular promotions.<ref name="TAL" />

In the original source, Rutu was not given either a species or gender; however, a subsequent entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' specified that the officer was a Ho'Din male.<ref name="CSWE" />
